abstract: Completing Task 13 and its parent, Task 4, to mark the successful development of the automated action logging system. The script then runs view_tasks.py for immediate verification.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys

UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"

# --- Mark tasks as completed ---
print("--- Completing Self-Monitoring Module Tasks ---")
# Mark sub-task 13 as completed
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "13", "completed"], check=True)
# Mark parent task 4 as completed
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "4", "completed"], check=True)
print("Tasks 13 and 4 have been marked as COMPLETED.")

# --- Verification ---
print("\\n--- Running verification ---")
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import view_tasks
from telos import task_manager
all_tasks = task_manager.load_tasks()
view_tasks.display_tasks(all_tasks)
print("--- Verification complete. ---")
